_source.title: 打开内联框架窗口
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口仅扩展包允许调用，用户需要在扩展包内包含用于内联的 HTML 文件；
_source.remarks.text.1: 本接口调用后将会打开一个 Dialog 窗口，该 Dialog 窗口的标题为 HTML 文件的 `<title>`，标题栏有关闭按钮；
_source.remarks.text.2: 正文部分为内联框架，`width` 和 `height` 均为正文部分内联框架的宽高；
_source.remarks.text.3: 内联框架需要展示 `htmlFileName` 的内容，该 HTML 从扩展包内获取，并已在安装时被存储至 IndexedDB 中
_source.remarks.text.4: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.htmlFileName: 需要加载的 HTML 文件在扩展包内的路径，从扩展根目录起始，例如 `/iframe/index.html`
_source.params.id: 内联框架窗口 ID，用于关闭内联框架窗口

title: Open iframe window
remarks.text.0: This API can only be called by extension packages. Users need to include an HTML file for embedding in the extension package;
remarks.text.1: After this API is called, a Dialog window will open. The title of the Dialog window is the `<title>` of the HTML file, and the title bar has a close button;
remarks.text.2: The body is an iframe. `width` and `height` are the width and height of the iframe in the body;
remarks.text.3: The iframe needs to display the content of `htmlFileName`. This HTML is obtained from the extension package and has been stored in IndexedDB during installation
remarks.text.4: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
params.htmlFileName: The path of the HTML file to load within the extension package, starting from the extension root directory, e.g. `/iframe/index.html`
params.id: Iframe window ID, used to close the iframe window
